sar.narrative: On November 25, 2016, at 22:21:00, the bank's autonomous monitor flagged suspicious activity on card C03633-K1, belonging to customer C03633. Between 21:00:00 and 21:21:00, a series of four online transactions occurred, totaling $1,935.29. The individual transaction amounts were $488.31 (at 21:00:00), $489.91 (at 21:10:00), $479.33 (at 21:18:00), and $477.74 (at 21:21:00). All four transactions were conducted online using billing address code '191'. The final transaction (ID 3487348) was associated with a MacOS device running Mac OS X 10_8_5 and Chrome 49.0, which was marked as 'Found' for this card. This activity is highly suspicious because the card is used almost exclusively in person, with only 4 of 108 prior transactions occurring online. Furthermore, the transaction amount of $477.74 is in the top 3% of this card's historical purchase amounts. The rapid succession of four transactions, each positioned just below $500, strongly suggests an intentional attempt to bypass a $500 authorization threshold. Consequently, a suspicious activity report is recommended.
